action.description: open opens or adds to a position; close closes what the slot holds in that market; target brings the position to long, short or flat; cancel withdraws followers' copy entries that have not filled. update does not modify an open position's protection — do not use it to move a stop. reverse is not accepted. action may be omitted when position, market_position or sentiment is sent (a target).

side.description: Required for open. A close needs no side.

orderType.description: Only market and limit are accepted.

oneOf.description: Percentage ("2%"), USD ("300 USD"), or token amount with a unit ("0.001 BTC"). A bare "$300" is NOT accepted - write "300 USD".

quantity.description: With no quantity, the slot's Trade Setting default size is used; a close with no quantity closes the whole position.

leverage.description: Capped by the slot's Trade Setting leverage.

marginMode.description: With none, the account's current setting for the market is kept.

takeProfits.description: Each level closes part of the position and must be at least the market's minimum order size. Keep the total of the amounts at or below the order quantity.

amount.description: Quantity to close at this level, in base tokens. Must be a positive number - percentage strings and keywords such as "remainder" are rejected with "TPn has invalid price or amount".

label.description: Optional name for the level, such as "TP1"

stopLossX.description: SLX settings. Accepted, but not placed for webhook signals yet — set SLX on the order ticket.

activationPoint.description: TP level that activates SLX in trailing_profits mode

stopLossX.title: SLXConfig

position.description: A target position. Also accepted as market_position, or as sentiment (bullish / bearish / flat).

position_size.description: Size for a target's new position. Also market_position_size.

timestamp.description: When the signal was sent — milliseconds, seconds or ISO. An opening signal more than 90 seconds old when it arrives is refused; a close never is. TradingView: "{{timenow}}".

dryRun.description: Return what would be placed and place nothing.

metadata.description: Your own data, stored with the signal.

targetShort.summary: Hold a short position (flips a long)
